brand.name: Logistra
brand.description: End-to-end e-commerce fulfilment for teams ready to move inventory out of the founder's hands.

home.title: Deliver Faster. Keep Your Customers.
home.body: Your customers shouldn't have to wait 7–9 days for an order just because your inventory is sitting far away. Logistra helps D2C brands place their best-selling products closer to customers—so you can deliver faster without significantly increasing delivery cost.
home.audience: For D2C brands · faster delivery · healthier unit economics

problem.title: Your product can be great. Your delivery experience can still lose the customer.
problem.body: When an order travels around 2,000 km to reach Eastern India, delivery can take 7–9 days. That distance shows up in the customer experience—and in the economics of every shipment.
problem.quote: Your customer doesn't care where your warehouse is. They care when their order arrives.

points.title: Slow delivery
points.body: Customers increasingly expect fast, predictable delivery. A long wait creates doubt after the checkout click.

points.title: Higher shipping cost
points.body: Long-distance fulfilment can increase the cost of each individual shipment as every order travels farther.

points.title: Lost customers
points.body: Customers may switch brands because of the delivery experience—not because your product is not good enough.

problem.close: You shouldn't have to choose between fast delivery and healthy unit economics.

solution.title: Move inventory closer to your customers.
solution.body: Logistra partners with D2C brands to store their fast-moving and best-selling products in locations closer to demand. You forward the order. We handle what happens next.
solution.note: No need to build your own distributed fulfilment network.

steps.title: Order received

steps.title: Customer gets it faster
steps.body: A shorter shipping distance means a faster, more predictable delivery experience.

solution.highlight: Faster delivery. Better customer experience. Approximately the same delivery cost per order.

sharedFulfilment.eyebrow: A smarter way to fulfil regional orders
sharedFulfilment.title: Your own brand. Shared infrastructure. Less operational burden.
sharedFulfilment.body: Expanding into a new region does not have to mean building and operating another warehouse. Logistra helps growing brands position selected products closer to customers in Eastern India through a shared fulfilment model. Instead of establishing a separate fulfilment operation, brands can use shared facilities and operational resources to support regional order fulfilment.
sharedFulfilment.detail: From receiving and storage to picking, packing, dispatch, and returns, Logistra manages the agreed operational workflow while your business continues to focus on building its brand.
benefits: Avoid the immediate need to build a dedicated regional fulfilment operation.
Position selected fast-selling products closer to regional customers.
Use an organised workflow for inventory, orders, dispatch, and returns.
Evaluate regional expansion without automatically committing to a standalone warehouse.
sharedFulfilment.note: Shared infrastructure does not mean shared inventory. Each brand’s stock, SKUs, and orders remain identified and controlled within the agreed operating model.

faqs.question: What is shared fulfilment?
faqs.answer: Shared fulfilment is a model where multiple brands can use common fulfilment infrastructure and operational resources. Each brand’s inventory, SKUs, and orders remain identified and controlled within the agreed operating process.

faqs.question: Do brands share inventory?
faqs.answer: No. Shared infrastructure does not mean combining stock. Brand inventory and orders should remain appropriately identified and controlled; the exact operating controls are agreed during assessment.

faqs.question: Can I use Logistra alongside my existing warehouse?
faqs.answer: That can be assessed. Many regional models begin with selected fast-moving SKUs while a brand continues using its existing setup for other inventory or destinations.

faqs.question: Which products should I move to a regional facility?
faqs.answer: Usually the discussion starts with best-selling products, regional demand, product dimensions and weight, replenishment practicality, and the cost of moving or holding inventory. Suitability is business-specific.

faqs.question: Which locations can Logistra currently serve?
faqs.answer: Logistra is based in Patna, Bihar, with a focus on Eastern India. Actual serviceability and delivery timelines depend on facility and carrier availability, so share target states, cities, or pincodes for assessment.

faqs.question: How is fulfilment pricing determined?
faqs.answer: Pricing depends on receiving, storage, handling, pick-and-pack, packaging, outbound shipping, returns, inventory transfers, optional services, and your order and product profile. Request a commercial estimate for your requirements.

faqs.question: How should I compare total fulfilment costs?
faqs.answer: Compare current long-distance shipping with the full proposed model, including inbound transfer, receiving, storage, pick-and-pack, outbound shipping, returns, and other agreed costs. Shorter outbound distance alone is not the full calculation.

faqs.question: How do my orders reach Logistra?
faqs.answer: The order handoff process should be agreed during assessment based on your channels, systems, and operating requirements. Do not assume a particular integration is available until it is confirmed.

faqs.question: How are returns handled?
faqs.answer: Returns can be received, inspected, classified, restocked, repacked, quarantined, or escalated according to the agreed workflow and product requirements.

faqs.question: How much inventory should I position regionally?
faqs.answer: That depends on regional demand, replenishment lead time, product profile, storage requirements, and the level of service you want to support. Logistra can assess the operating assumptions with you.

faqs.question: What information is required for a quotation?
faqs.answer: Useful inputs include product type, size and weight, monthly orders, current inventory location, customer geography, best-selling SKUs, storage and replenishment needs, and any required order-transfer process.

faqs.question: How do I get started?
faqs.answer: Partner with Logistra through the enquiry form. Share your business and fulfilment requirements, then discuss suitability, commercials, responsibilities, inventory planning, and the first operating step.

about.title: Built around the realities of growing brands.
about.body: Logistra exists for the point where fulfilment has become too important to improvise, but too personal to hand to a faceless machine.
about.statementBody: We believe the best fulfilment partner is not the one with the loudest claims. It is the one that knows where your inventory is, what your customer needs, and what should happen next.
about.principlesBody: A reliable operation is a business advantage. We treat it that way.

principles.title: Stay close to the work

principles.title: Grow at the right pace
